description: This Java source file defines an enumeration of well-known headers ('Ditto Headers') used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies header names, their data types, whether they are read from or written to external headers, and validation strategies. The enumeration facilitates header management and validation within the project.

classes.name: DittoHeaderDefinition
classes.description: Enumeration representing various well-known Ditto header definitions, with their key, data type, validation, and properties indicating external read/write capabilities.

methods.name: forKey
methods.description: Looks up a header definition by its key, returning an Optional containing the HeaderDefinition if found.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type associated with the header.

methods.name: getSerializationType
methods.description: Returns the class type used for serialization of the header value.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether the header should be read from external sources.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether the header should be written to external sources.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided header value using the associated validator.
